tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground. Warm off-white in light, warm charcoal in dark.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panes, inputs and popovers sitting on bg-canvas.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Row hover, quiet fills, secondary button hover.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Disabled controls, code blocks, inset wells, ghost hover.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: Current row or selected item. Pair with a 2px brand edge.

tokens.name: notch-cut
tokens.usage: Paints the folded corner of a notched surface. Set to the actual background when a notched surface is not on bg-canvas.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Section rules inside a surface, table row separators.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Default 1px structural border on cards and panes.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover border on cards and cells; dashed locked outlines.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, buttons and other controls. At least 3:1 on bg-surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body and headings on bg-canvas, bg-surface, bg-subtle. 7:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy on bg-surface, bg-canvas, bg-inset and bg-selected.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, mono labels on bg-surface, bg-canvas, bg-subtle and bg-selected.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled ink only; exempt from contrast.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Glyph or text on a solid stage fill (verified cells, stamps).

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Inline links on bg-surface and bg-canvas.

tokens.name: focus-ring
